title.narrative: Program to Strengthen the Labor Intermediation System in Chile
Programa de Fortalecimiento del Sistema de Intermediacin Laboral en Chile

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es mejorar la integracin y la provisin de servicios de intermediacin laboral a buscadores de empleo y empresas en Chile. Para ello, apoyar acciones de poltica dirigidas al logro de los siguientes objetivos especficos: (i) reformular el modelo de gobernanza de las entidades pblicas del Sistema de Intermediacin Laboral (SIL); (ii) adecuar la oferta y la prestacin de los Servicios de Intermediacin Laboral (SSIL) provistos por entidades pblicas y restructurar su modelo de gestin; y (iii) avanzar hacia la ampliacin y articulacin de un Sistema de Informacin del Mercado Laboral (SIML) y la generacin de conocimiento del sector.

The program's objective is to improve the integration and delivery of labor intermediation services for job seekers and companies in Chile. To that end, it will support policy actions aimed at achieving the following specific objectives: (i) reformulate the governance model of the public agencies operating in the labor intermediation system; (ii) match the supply and delivery of labor intermediation services provided by public agencies and restructure the management model for these services; and (iii) move forward with the expansion and coordination of a labor market information system and the generation sector knowledge
